A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as the '''chief pilot''' and [[master-at-arms]] aboard the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Barderia]]''.

==Biography==
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]]&mdash;[[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise&mdash;attacked and boarded the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''Barderia'' while she was on a trade trip. The chief [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] showed a tough demeanor upon meeting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garik Loran|Kargin]], who was Wraith pilot [[Garik Loran]] in disguise.<ref name="if" />

A second attack was again staged on the ''Barderia'' upon her return trip back to the [[Halmad system/Legends|Halmad system]].<ref name="if" />
